description: This file implements RPC server and client setup functions for Android's binder IPC mechanism, including support for various socket types and transport modes, with functions for creating, configuring, starting, and shutting down RPC servers and sessions.

methods.name: ARpcServer_newVsock
methods.description: Creates a new RPC server bound to a vsock port with optional connection filtering based on CID.

methods.name: ARpcServer_newInitUnixDomain
methods.description: Creates a new Unix domain socket RPC server using a control socket identified by name.

methods.name: ARpcServer_newUnixDomainBootstrap
methods.description: Creates a new Unix domain socket RPC server using a bootstrap file descriptor.

methods.name: ARpcServer_newInet
methods.description: Creates a new internet (TCP/IP) RPC server bound to a specified address and port.

methods.name: ARpcServer_setSupportedFileDescriptorTransportModes
methods.description: Sets supported file descriptor transport modes for the server.

methods.name: ARpcSession_setupVsockClient
methods.description: Sets up a vsock client connection within a session.

methods.name: ARpcSession_setupUnixDomainClient
methods.description: Sets up a Unix domain socket client connection within a session.

methods.name: ARpcSession_setupUnixDomainBootstrapClient
methods.description: Sets up a Unix domain socket bootstrap client connection.

methods.name: ARpcSession_setupInet
methods.description: Sets up an internet (TCP/IP) client connection.

methods.name: ARpcSession_setupPreconnectedClient
methods.description: Sets up a preconnected client with a custom request FD.

methods.name: ARpcSession_setFileDescriptorTransportMode
methods.description: Configures the file descriptor transport mode for the session.

methods.name: ARpcSession_setMaxIncomingThreads
methods.description: Sets maximum incoming threads for the session.

methods.name: ARpcSession_setMaxOutgoingConnections
methods.description: Sets maximum outgoing connections for the session.
